name: Insights & Diagnostics Workflow
description: Verifies the Insights & Diagnostics tab: bottleneck banner, System Health, Storage Growth, Power & Battery, and Network Privacy panels, plus the storage scan.

planSteps.description: Assert the status banner shows 'System Healthy' or a diagnostic alert matching the bottleneck engine state
Switch to the Storage Growth tab
Assert folder growth rows display Name, Current Size, Growth Today, and Growth This Week
Assert the scan runs in the background without freezing the UI and the button disables while scanning
Assert sleep blockers list and browser tab energy ranker render (or empty states)
Assert telemetry alerts, today's top uploads, and contacted servers tables render from lsof output
Assert the UI remains fully interactive during the 5-second telemetry refresh (lsof/pmset run off the main actor with timeouts)
